subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.**

You will be given a ticket by the manager.

options.text: A ticket will be given to you by the manager.
The manager will give you a ticket.
The ticket was given to you by the manager.
The manager should give you a ticket.

solution:
The correct answer is **"The manager will give you a ticket."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in Simple Future Tense and in Passive Voice.
 
• The rule for changing a Simple Future Tense from Active voice to Passive voice or Passive to Active Voice:
 
 
• To convert a sentence from passive voice to active voice, we need to identify the subject (who is performing the action) and make it the subject of the sentence.
 
 
 
• Structure: 
 
 
• Subject + will + V1 + object (Active Voice__)
 
• Object + will + be + V3 + by Subject __(Passive Voice)__ 
 
 
 
• Example: 
 
 
• *Esha will sing a song.** *(Active Voice)
 
• *A song will be sung by Esha.​ *(Passive Voice)
 
 
 
• In active voice, the subject (manager) performs the action (giving the ticket) on the object (you).
 
• In this case, the subject is **"the manager"** and the object is** "you," **so we can say **"The manager will give you a ticket."**
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.
